introHtml: PL badge ID holders offer a reliable, clear vinyl construction that keeps credentials visible and protected. Whether you need standard badge pouches for daily employee IDs or heavy-duty holders for tradeshow access, these plastic holders hold up to frequent use. Add your logo or department color with screen printing or a full-color insert for a professional look that reinforces your brand every time an ID is scanned.
